title: The Last Collection Is an Operational Event
author: RN Collins
principle: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

narrativeSequence.caption: A final collection is an operational event: orders, staff, collaborators, IP, files, samples, money, promises, and public language require decisions even when creative work stops.
Made after Charles Frederick Worth’s death, the dress lets the house name continue in the record without proving who controlled every creative or economic decision.

01 · STABILIZE — Who and what need an answer today?. Inventory safety, payroll, benefits, contractors, customers, deposits, deadlines, facilities, systems, insurers, lenders, and emergency contacts. Identify the authorized interim decision-maker from actual records.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 02 · FREEZE — Which changes should stop?. Preserve files, samples, accounts, logs, agreements, permissions, money movements, and public drafts; suspend deletion and irreversible publication while legal holds, privacy, and access are reviewed.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 03 · DECIDE — Can unfinished work continue?. Assess creative authority, contributor consent, labor, contract, quality, finance, rights, customer, cultural, and reputational consequences for ship, pause, complete, transfer, or cancel.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: 04 · ACCOUNT — How will the institution explain the outcome?. Publish only verified decisions, preserve dissent and credits, notify affected parties before spectacle, record refunds or remedies, and archive the rationale and authority.
narrativeSequence.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

narrativeSequence.caption: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.
narrativeSequence.rights: Link and quote narrowly; check each downloadable resource before redistribution.
